raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Upstream #42494 now defers diffusion quantization imports until registry lookup, fixing the cold `LinearBase` import cycle originally reported here. Its lookup still imports every backend and no longer exposes the configuration classes directly from the package. This PR resolves only the requested backend while retaining the previous package-level class exports, registry aliases, and custom registration behavior.

## Changes

Keep `QuantizationConfig` available during package initialization. Resolve and cache implementation classes through module `__getattr__`, and look up built-in configurations by their export name. Preserve `kitchen_int8` → `convrot_int8`, distinct ModelOpt configuration classes, and user-defined configurations.

Fresh-process regression tests cover `linear`, `hf_diffusers_utils`, the standalone AR module, and ConvRot config imports. Registry tests cover all built-ins, package exports, repeated lookups, the deprecated alias, and custom registration failures.

## Validation

Synced with upstream `bab04cd7913ff50d1bf1a677a2d10e5015dc4c3b`, including #42494. This preserves the upstream HIP H3 and CI changes.

RTX 5090 D v2, Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130:

- **117 passed, 24 subtests passed** across cold imports/registry, import isolation, ConvRot backends, and transformer quantization.
- Changed-file pre-commit and `git diff --check` passed.
- Complete source content verified against the local Git index and working-tree changes before the remote run. Cold subprocesses use Hugging Face offline mode.

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_quantization_imports.py \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_diffusion_import_isolation.py \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_convrot_int8_backends.py \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_transformer_quant.py
```

Earlier native AMD CI passed the four cold-import checks on a previous head; the synchronized head still needs hosted AMD validation. No model-forward math, precision, thresholds, or inference speedup claim. Codex assisted with implementation and testing.

The suite may need a targeted rerun or partitioning to establish completion within its budget.

Those timings need same-runner base comparison; thresholds remain unchanged. NPU still fails at the wheel download (403), before model tests.

The separate FP8 fix #42255 has now passed its targeted tests on real MI300 hardware. The other platform-policy/fallback fixes #42250/#42256/#42257 still await CI authorization.

Synced with upstream `ce617d4`, including #42240's LTX dispatch correction and the merged FP8 fix #42255. The lazy-import implementation and four independent cold-import regressions are unchanged.

Further inspection of the previous AMD timeout found that the existing nine performance-failure runner tests occupied about **1,366.5 s** of the 1,800 s step budget, from adjacent log timestamps. Each scenario restarts pytest for an initial attempt plus six retries: **63 pytest startups**. The four new cold imports separately took **47.5 s**, so I am not claiming zero contribution from this PR's test cost. The separate test-only fix #42359 batches the nine independently parametrized scenarios into the same seven real attempts, preserving per-case failure/metric/JUnit checks.

On the updated head `2909028`: **116 passed + 22 passing subtests**, 42.13 s pytest (53.60 s whole process), in the combined import/isolation/ConvRot/transformer-quant suite. Source tree verified: 4,127 Python files, zero mismatches or extras. Changed-file pre-commit passes. Environment: RTX 5090 D v2 / Torch 2.13.0+cu130.

#42359's complete file was separately measured on the same host: upstream 888.28 s -> candidate 117.36 s (**86.8% less time**). All nine child scenarios still run seven times; the complete file also passes with an already-expired outer retry budget. These are local test-runtime results, not a claim that the full AMD suite now passes. No timeout/threshold/retry-limit changes.

Source hashes, diffs, and logs for that validation: https://github.com/Tokha233/ComfyUI-H3-SpeedKit/tree/8791760/evidence/pr-maintenance-1005 .

The existing retry-budget guard declined attempt 7 (142.8 s left vs estimated 146.0 s needed). The initial `fsdp-inference` and `ltx_2_two_stage_t2v` failures recovered on attempt 2. **H3 Ref2VA passed both requests and both consistency checks in this partition.**
- [2-GPU partition 0](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37256707983/job/111595380649) was stopped by the existing fail-fast health check after 1-GPU partition 3 failed; its tests did not execute. The later coverage failure includes ten missing 2-GPU cases, including H3 T2VA, so this run does **not** validate those cases.
- [2-GPU partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37256707983/job/111595380623) passed on attempt 2; LTX-2.5 decoder E2E and Wan load latency failed initially. This is retry recovery, not proof of stable latency.

Current-head [AMD](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37256707869) has now finished **failed, with 5/6 diffusion partitions passed**. [2-GPU partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37256707869/job/111595295296) again hit the **180-minute step timeout** at 06:45 UTC. Its first pass reported **13 passed, 1 skipped, 1 error**; **H3 T2VA and Ref2VA both passed**. The only reported case error was `ltx_2_5_diffusion_decoder_2gpus`: six completed attempts each reported `Server not ready within 1200.0s`; attempt 7 was still warming up when the overall step timed out. This is different from the previous head's seven completed readiness timeouts. On every current-head attempt both ranks logged the 3-tile decoder split; the last logs show Inductor warnings. This reproduces the startup failure across two heads, but still does not identify its underlying cause. A diagnostic run capturing both rank stacks around tile decode/FlexAttention compilation and the final tile gather, with GPU utilization, is preferable to another blind retry. The observed current CUDA failures are timing guards, not SSIM/import assertions, but without a same-runner base comparison their relationship to this PR is still unproven. A maintainer-side same-runner base/head comparison for the two persistent timing cases, followed by completion of the fail-fast-skipped partition, would help distinguish a regression from CI timing instability. No performance threshold, timeout, or retry setting has been changed.

<details>
<summary>Previous-head results (`b62a8588`; retained for history, not current-head validation)</summary>

- Previous-head [CUDA base](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37233368340), [XPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37233368261), and [NPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37233368242) completed successfully. The CUDA diffusion unit suite reported **3,831 passed, 134 skipped, 3 xfailed, and 353 passing subtests**.
- Previous-head AMD finished with **5/6 diffusion partitions successful**. In [2-GPU partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37233368455/job/111527621417), the initial pass reported **13 passed, 1 skipped, 1 error**. Both `minimax_h3_t2va_2gpu_h100` and `minimax_h3_ref2va_video_audio_2gpu_h100` passed their two requests. The remaining error was `ltx_2_5_diffusion_decoder_2gpus`: **server readiness timeout after 1,200 seconds on all seven attempts**, followed by the workflow step's **180-minute timeout**. The last warmup logs reach diffusion decoder tiling (3 tiles across 2 ranks) and Inductor warnings; they do not establish the underlying stall's cause. This was a startup/warmup timeout, not an SSIM assertion. The maintainer sync did not change `python/sglang/multimodal_gen`, so it should not be described as a proven fix for that timeout.
- Previous-head CUDA [2-GPU partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37233368340/job/111527668685) passed on attempt 6 under the existing retry policy. LTX average denoise was 390.36 / 325.26 / 361.57 / 455.01 / 396.37 ms on failed attempts, then 267.01 ms on the passing attempt. Wan also had an initial load-latency failure. This is eventual CI success, not evidence of stable LTX latency or a proven performance fix.

No tolerance, startup timeout, or retry policy has been changed by this PR.

</details>

+"""Regression coverage for cold diffusion imports and quantization dispatch."""
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers import quantization
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "module",
+    [
+        "runtime.layers.linear",
+        "runtime.utils.hf_diffusers_utils",
+        "test.single_test_file.test_ar_models",
+        "runtime.layers.quantization.configs.convrot_int8_config",
+    ],
+)
+def test_cold_import(module):
+    # A new interpreter is necessary: pytest's conftest imports the registry first.
+    completed = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-c",
+            f"import importlib; importlib.import_module('sglang.multimodal_gen.{module}')",
+        ],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        timeout=60,
+        env={**os.environ, "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1"},
+    )
+    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stdout + completed.stderr
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "method,name",
+    [
+        ("auto-round", "AutoRoundConfig"),
+        ("bitsandbytes", "BitsAndBytesConfig"),
+        ("modelopt", "ModelOptFp8DiffusionConfig"),
+        ("modelopt_fp8", "ModelOptFp8Config"),
+        ("modelopt_fp4", "ModelOptFp4Config"),
+        ("modelslim", "ModelSlimConfig"),
+        ("fp8", "Fp8Config"),
+        ("mxfp4", "Mxfp4Config"),
+        ("mxfp8", "MXFP8Config"),
+        ("mxfp4_npu", "NPUMXFP4Config"),
+        ("convrot_int8", "ConvRotInt8Config"),
+        ("kitchen_int8", "ConvRotInt8Config"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_builtin_config_and_package_export(method, name):
+    config = quantization.get_quantization_config(method)
+    assert issubclass(config, quantization.QuantizationConfig)
+    assert config is getattr(quantization, name)
+    assert quantization.get_quantization_config(method) is config
+
+
+def test_custom_registration(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(quantization, "_CUSTOMIZED_METHOD_TO_QUANT_CONFIG", {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        quantization, "QUANTIZATION_METHODS", list(quantization.QUANTIZATION_METHODS)
+    )
+
+    class CustomConfig(quantization.QuantizationConfig):
+        pass
+
+    assert (
+        quantization.register_quantization_config("test-custom")(CustomConfig)
+        is CustomConfig
+    )
+    assert quantization.get_quantization_config("test-custom") is CustomConfig
+    for name in ("test-custom", "fp8", "kitchen_int8"):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already exists"):
+            quantization.register_quantization_config(name)(CustomConfig)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="subclass"):
+        quantization.register_quantization_config("invalid-config")(object)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid quantization method"):
+        quantization.get_quantization_config("unknown")
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError, match="no attribute"):
+        getattr(quantization, "UnknownConfig")
